meta.description: Single workflow that ingests a chapter PDF, structures its knowledge, dynamically selects one of 18 prompt templates by (question_type x difficulty), generates questions with an LLM, validates them, removes duplicates against the existing bank, and stores the final JSON in a Board/Class/Chapter/Type/Difficulty folder tree on Google Drive.

parameters.formDescription: Generate a CBSE Chemistry question bank from a chapter PDF.

options.formSubmittedText: Generation started. You'll find the JSON in Google Drive when done.

nodes.name: Load Existing Question Bank
nodes.notes: Lists files inside the target folder so the duplicate-detector can fetch recent question stems. Runs AFTER folders are ensured (see connection ordering).

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx = $json;
const templates = $vars.PROMPT_TEMPLATES;   // injected via n8n environment variable (JSON string)
const tpl = typeof templates === 'string' ? JSON.parse(templates) : templates;
const key = ctx.prompt_key;
const entry = tpl[key];
if (!entry) throw new Error('No prompt template for key ' + key);

const footer = tpl._meta.shared_footer
  .replaceAll('{{number_of_questions}}', String(ctx.number_of_questions))
  .replaceAll('{{chapter_code}}', ctx.chapter_code)
  .replaceAll('{{existing_question_stems}}', JSON.stringify(ctx.existing_stems || []));

const body = [
  entry.instruction,
  'Rules:\n- ' + entry.rules.join('\n- '),
  '',
  'Context:',
  `board=${ctx.board}`,
  `class=${ctx.class_name}`,
  `chapter=${ctx.chapter}`,
  `source_type=${ctx.source_type}`,
  `language=${ctx.language}`,
  `include_visual_questions=${ctx.include_visual_questions}`,
  `generate_explanation=${ctx.generate_explanation}`,
  `batch_id=${ctx.batch_id}`,
  '',
  'CHAPTER KNOWLEDGE (use ONLY this):',
  JSON.stringify(ctx.chapter_knowledge),
  '',
  footer
].join('\n')
 .replaceAll('{{board}}', ctx.board)
 .replaceAll('{{class}}', ctx.class_name)
 .replaceAll('{{chapter}}', ctx.chapter)
 .replaceAll('{{source_type}}', ctx.source_type)
 .replaceAll('{{language}}', ctx.language)
 .replaceAll('{{include_visual_questions}}', String(ctx.include_visual_questions))
 .replaceAll('{{generate_explanation}}', String(ctx.generate_explanation));

return [{ json: { ...ctx, prompt_user_message: body, attempt: (ctx.attempt || 0) + 1 } }];

const err = $json.error || $json;
return [{ json: { status: 'FAILED', stage: $json.node || 'unknown', message: err.message || String(err), batch_id: $('Normalize Input').first()?.json?.batch_id } }];

_environment_variables_required.PROMPT_TEMPLATES: Contents of prompts/templates.json (as a JSON string)

_credentials_required.anthropicApi: Anthropic API credential for Claude (used by Structurer, Generator, Validator)
_credentials_required.googleDriveOAuth2Api: Google Drive OAuth2 credential with drive.file scope
